intent: Create a new task in the In Progress column: title "Add logging middleware to API gateway", priority High, story points 3, and assign it to any team member.
Reassign the task "Create RESTful API documentation with OpenAPI spec" to Emma Johnson, bump the story points to 5, and move it to In Progress.
Find Frank Lee's two backlog tasks and add both to Sprint 2.
Add two subtasks: "Write happy-path tests" and "Write edge case tests." to task "Write unit tests for payment processing module". Then mark the happy-path one as done.
Carol White is switching teams. Reassign all her To Do tasks to Bob Martinez, and move her In Review task to Done, it's been approved. Don't touch her already-completed work.
We need to staff up the backlog before sprint planning. Assign Frank Lee to every unassigned backlog task and add them all to Sprint 3.
Move every high-priority task currently in the To Do column to In Progress — those all need to be worked on immediately.
David Kim is overloaded. Reduce the priority of each of his tasks by one level (critical becomes high, high becomes medium, medium becomes low).

Create a new To Do task with these details:
- Title: "Implement webhook event delivery system"
- Description: "Build a reliable webhook delivery system with retry logic and failure alerting."
- Assignee: Frank Lee
- Priority: Critical
- Story Points: 8
- Tags: backend, devops

Do all of the following: filter by Priority "Critical" to review critical tasks, then open the Safari login redirect-loop bug and reassign it to Bob Martinez with 3 story points. Clear the filter, then create a new task titled "Conduct security penetration testing" assigned to Carol White, priority Critical, 13 story points, tags "security" and "testing", and move it to In Progress. Also move "Add dark mode support to component library" to In Progress.

Open the authentication task "Implement user authentication with OAuth2" and link it to the memory leak task with a "blocks" relationship and to the analytics dashboard layout task with a "relates to" relationship.
David Kim is going on leave. Reassign all of his tasks that are currently In Progress to Alice Chen so nothing stalls.
We underestimated the review effort across both the current Sprint 2 board and earlier completed work. Add 2 story points to every top-level task that starts in In Review.
We need better visibility on critical items across the active sprint, earlier completed work, and the backlog. Add a tag called 'urgent' to every top-level Critical-priority task.

QA found regressions in work that was already completed in the earlier sprint. Instead of reopening the original tickets, create review tickets for that completed work in Sprint 2's In Review column. For each new ticket, use the duplicate ticket relation to link it back to the original case, and set story points to 0.5 because only review is required.
Every story that's currently In Progress needs to be broken down. Add a subtask called 'Write acceptance criteria' to each one.

The OAuth2 authentication task is a prerequisite for our Sprint 2 frontend work. Link every other top-level frontend-tagged task in Sprint 2 to that authentication task with a 'blocked by' relationship. Ignore subtasks or tasks outside Sprint 2.
Let's load up Sprint 3 with the important backlog items. Add every backlog task that has High or Critical priority to Sprint 3.
We're re-doing sprint assignments in planning. Remove the assignee from every top-level To Do task in both the active Sprint 2 board and the backlog so we can start fresh.

Sprint 2 is done — complete it. Create 'Sprint 4' with goal 'Carry-over items and bug fixes', then move every top-level Sprint 2 To Do task back to the backlog and move every top-level Sprint 2 In Progress or In Review task into Sprint 4.

Before tomorrow's planning, get the security work organized. Review only security-tagged items first, start the OAuth2 story, send the Safari login redirect-loop bug to In Review, pull the admin audit log dashboard and the SAML SSO work into Sprint 3, assign the SAML SSO work to Frank Lee, create a Sprint 3 task titled "Run SSO security readiness review" for Emma Johnson with High priority, 5 story points, and the security and testing tags, start it right away, add a subtask "Document IdP metadata test cases" under it and mark that subtask done, then link both the new review task and the SAML SSO work to the OAuth2 story as blocked by.

Get the database migration weekend ready. Start Frank Lee's PostgreSQL 15 migration task, pull the automated database backups task and the Kubernetes staging cluster task into Sprint 2, create a Sprint 2 task titled "Run backup restore rehearsal before Postgres 15 cutover" assigned to Frank Lee with High priority, 3 story points, and the backend, devops, and testing tags, start it immediately, link it so it blocks the PostgreSQL migration task, break that migration task into three subtasks called "Validate migration dry run in staging", "Verify rollback timing under load", and "Confirm backup restore point coverage", mark the dry-run and backup-coverage subtasks done, and reassign the payment test task to Frank Lee so the verification work stays with the migration owner.

Before the design review, clean up the frontend stream. Look only at frontend-tagged work, start dark mode support and Core Web Vitals optimization, move Alice Chen's notifications story to In Review, mark the image optimization task done, bring the i18n backlog story and the accessibility backlog story into Sprint 3, reassign the accessibility backlog story to Alice Chen, create a Sprint 3 task called "Run dark mode and i18n accessibility regression pass" for Emma Johnson with High priority, 5 story points, and the frontend, testing, and design tags, send that new task to In Review, link it to dark mode support and the i18n backlog story as related work, and add a subtask called "Screen reader spot-check on translated pages" under it.

Set up Sprint 3 so the platform team can start cleanly. Start Sprint 3, add the GraphQL migration, database backups, staging cluster, and enterprise SSO backlog items to it, assign the enterprise SSO work to Bob Martinez, create a Sprint 3 task titled "Run Sprint 3 platform risk review" assigned to David Kim with Critical priority, 8 story points, and the backend, devops, and security tags, move that new task to In Progress, link it so it blocks the enterprise SSO work and relates to the automated database backups task, add two subtasks under it called "Check GraphQL rollout fallback plan" and "Review SSO certificate rotation path", and mark the certificate-rotation subtask done.

Before planning, analyze the current Sprint 2 workload by assignee. Create a To Do task titled "Sprint 2 Story Points Summary" assigned to Emma Johnson with Medium priority, 3 story points, and the docs tag. In the description, write only a JSON object mapping each team member's full name to their total top-level Sprint 2 story points.
